Title: Some admins may see outdated device inventory and update status information in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center

User impact: Admins may see outdated device inventory and update status information in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center.

More info: Device updates are continuing as expected, but the reported status and insights may not reflect the latest device state.

Current status: We’ve been alerted through our internal monitors and a subset of affected users to an issue in which admins may see outdated device inventory and update status information in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center. We’re reviewing service health telemetry specific to when impact first occurred so that we can refine our understanding of how impact arose, which we anticipate will help ascertain our next troubleshooting actions.

Scope of impact: Admins attempting to view device inventory and update status information in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center may be affected. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Start time: Thursday, August 20, 2026, at 12:00 AM UTC

Next update by: Sunday, August 23, 2026, at 9:00 PM UTC

Title: Some admins may see outdated device inventory and update status information in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center

User impact: Admins may have seen outdated device inventory and update status information in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center.

More info: Device updates continued as expected, but the reported status and insights might not have reflected the latest device state in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center.

Final status: We've determined that a recent standard update to improve service functionality introduced an impacting code regression, which was producing the outdated device inventory and update status information in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center. After deploying our code fix and removing the isolated code regression, a queued collection of service requests required processing before the impact was resolved. Our internal service telemetry has verified that, following our completed request processing, the impact has been remediated. 

Scope of impact: This issue affected any admin attempting to view device inventory and update status information in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center. 

Start time: Thursday, August 20, 2026, at 12:00 AM UTC

End time: Tuesday, August 25, 2026, at 7:00 AM UTC

Root cause: A standard .NET service update to improve service functionality had introduced an impacting code regression.

Next steps: 
- We're further analyzing the offending .NET improvements to help us improve our pre-deployment testing and validation processes to prevent similar impact from occurring in the future.

This is the final update for the event.
